vcu_g_0159_20001538.name: display_gauge_interval
vcu_g_0159_20001538.description: Step interval of the VCU_0159 level gauge in gauge ticks, computed as FUN_0800f050(level, 0, 100, 10) from the requested level. vcu_level_gauge_update_v0159 steps the gauge when display_gauge_tick (0x20001504) reaches it.

vcu_g_0159_2000153a.name: display_gauge_warn_timer
vcu_g_0159_2000153a.description: 300-tick timer of the VCU_0159 level gauge for the warning cycling (display_gauge_warn_idx, 0x20001503). Set to 0 while no warning is active; while warnings are shown it counts 300 ticks before display_gauge_warn_idx advances.

vcu_g_0159_2000153c.name: display_state0c_ticks
vcu_g_0159_2000153c.description: Step counter of display state 0x0C (display init and refresh). Below 500 each tick sends the controller init/refresh command sequence and the counter goes up by 1; from 500 it goes up by 2 until it passes 699, then it wraps to 0.

vcu_g_0159_20001548.name: display_digit_glyphs_159
vcu_g_0159_20001548.description: Digit glyph tables: seg_a at 0x20001548, seg_b at 0x20001552 and seg_c at 0x2000155c, ten entries each, indexed by the decimal digit 0..9. lcd_fb_show_digit_units and lcd_fb_show_number_2digit copy them into LED frame bytes 0x200021ca/0x200021cb/0x200021cc (units digit) and 0x200021c6/0x200021c7/0x200021c8 (tens digit). The family map places the same table at 0x20001494 in VCU_148 and VCU_14A..VCU_14F (read there by FUN_0800b84c). Not written in this packet, so probably constant data or set once at boot.

vcu_g_0159_20001566.name: led_pattern_idx_std
vcu_g_0159_20001566.description: Index table of the LED row animation, default set (used unless the mode byte DAT_20001fa7 is 1, 2 or 5). 18 rows of 10 bytes: row r gives count (byte 0) and then up to 9 LED frame byte indices (bytes 1..9) that are ORed with the matching masks from led_pattern_mask_std. Rows 0..8 are drawn rising and 9..17 falling by vcu_led_pattern_anim_step.

vcu_g_0159_2000161a.name: led_pattern_mask_std
vcu_g_0159_2000161a.description: Bit-mask table of the LED row animation, default set, paired with led_pattern_idx_std: entry k of row r is the bit mask ORed (or cleared) into the LED frame byte named by entry k of the index table. Byte 0 of each row is unused. 18 rows of 10 bytes.

vcu_g_0159_200016ce.name: led_pattern_idx_alt
vcu_g_0159_200016ce.description: Index table of the LED row animation, alternate set (used when the mode byte DAT_20001fa7 is 1, 2 or 5), same layout as led_pattern_idx_std: 18 rows of count plus 9 frame byte indices.

vcu_g_0159_20001782.name: led_pattern_mask_alt
vcu_g_0159_20001782.description: Bit-mask table of the LED row animation, alternate set, paired with led_pattern_idx_alt (same layout as led_pattern_mask_std). 18 rows of 10 bytes.

vcu_g_0159_20001cf4.name: display_speed_value
vcu_g_0159_20001cf4.description: 16-bit copy of the status value DAT_20001fa4 (speed or drive value), taken each tick by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. Its low byte is passed to the display digit writer FUN_0800c698 by display states 3 and 8.

vcu_g_0159_20001d0a.name: display_input_b_hold
vcu_g_0159_20001d0a.description: 1 while input B is in the long-hold state that starts the vehicle (vcu_input_b_hold_start_tick sets it when the hold reaches state 3, and clears it otherwise). It sets bit 3 of the display flag words (display_state3_flags, display_state8_flags, display_153_flags).

vcu_g_0159_20001d26.name: vehicle_submode_flag
vcu_g_0159_20001d26.description: Copy of bit 0 of the status word DAT_20001aee (drive sub-mode), taken each tick by vcu_speed_mode_snapshot_update. The display flag words use it as bit 6.

vcu_g_0159_20001d36.name: display_countdown_state
vcu_g_0159_20001d36.description: Start-countdown handshake state: 0 = idle (normal display), 1 = countdown started by vcu_countdown_start_handshake, 2 = countdown finished (set by display state 3 or 8 after 400 ticks, cleared by vcu_0159_080047ac and vcu_0159_080054ec). Non-zero selects the countdown branch of the renderer.

vcu_g_0159_20001f45.name: display_countdown_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f45.description: Request flag for the start countdown: set to 1 by vcu_0159_080054ec and consumed (cleared) by vcu_countdown_start_handshake, which then starts the countdown display and sends the 0x7A message to peer 7 when it finishes.

vcu_g_0159_20001f65.name: display_alert_request
vcu_g_0159_20001f65.description: One-shot alert request: set to 1 by vcu_0159_080054ec. The renderer runs a two-step alert pulse (display_pulse_count, driven by display_state3_phase30) while it is set and clears it at the end of the pulse.

vcu_g_153_20001fb2.name: display_indicator_gate
vcu_g_153_20001fb2.description: VCU_153 build: gate flag of the indicator/blink sequence. The sequence (display_153_blink_ticks, 0x20001522) runs while it is 1; the state-2 periodic tick sets it when the indicator state DAT_20001fa8 is set (probably), and the renderer clears it when the sequence ends. The deep-sleep restore function clears it as well.

vcu_g_0159_20001fbf.name: display_anim_done
vcu_g_0159_20001fbf.description: Completion flag of the LED frame sequence: set to 1 by the row animation when a sequence has finished (probably), used by display state 4, which runs the row animation while it is 0 and returns early unless it is 1 and by vcu_double_pulse_indicator_step, and cleared when a new sequence starts.

vcu_g_0159_20001fc4.name: display_blink_active
vcu_g_0159_20001fc4.description: 1 while the state-2 blink sequence is running (display_state2_blink_ticks and display_state2_flash_ticks count it). Set by vcu_state2_periodic_tick, cleared when the sequence ends and in vcu_deep_sleep_enter_and_restore.

vcu_g_0159_20001fd1.name: input_pb14_stage
vcu_g_0159_20001fd1.description: Stage of the PB14 timed edge-count sequence run by vcu_pb14_timed_edge_sequence: 0 = idle, 1 = started, 2 and up = counting edges in the 200 and 700 tick windows, 6 = finished or timed out. The renderer treats stages above 2 other than 6 as an active sequence.

vcu_g_0159_2000202c.name: display_alarm_request
vcu_g_0159_2000202c.description: Request flag set to 1 by vcu_state2_periodic_tick under a condition on the flags 0x20001fb4 and 0x20001f69 (not in this packet), and read and cleared by vcu_0159_080047ac. Probably an alarm request for the state-2 display.

vcu_g_0159_2000202e.name: display_last_digit
vcu_g_0159_2000202e.description: Copy of the digit or value in 0x2000202d from the previous state-2 render tick. A change restarts the state-2 change animation (display_state2_change_ticks). Cleared by vcu_nibble_count_snapshot.

vcu_g_0159_20002050.name: code_entry_count
vcu_g_0159_20002050.description: Number of digits accepted so far in the 4-digit code entry: incremented by vcu_code_digit_entry_tick each time the cursor 0x2000202d reaches it. The state-2 renderer draws 2 or 3 LED bars for the values 2 and 3. Cleared by vcu_nibble_count_snapshot.

vcu_g_0159_200021c6.name: led_digit_bank
vcu_g_0159_200021c6.description: Eight LED/LCD frame bytes c6..cd holding the two digits of the display: the tens digit uses c6..c8 and the units digit uses ca..cc (segment bytes from the glyph tables), c9 and cb/cd hold icon-group bits (mask 0x70) and cd also holds a low-nibble segment pattern. Cleared at the start of each state and rebuilt every tick by the renderer and the helpers. Sent to the TM1640-style driver by vcu_led_tm1640_frame_commit. Byte 0x200021ce and later bytes belong to other packets.

vcu_g_0159_200021d1.name: led_indicator_d1
vcu_g_0159_200021d1.description: LED frame byte d1 of indicator bits: bit 0 is channel 9 of the 9-channel LED mask (set by vcu_chan_mask_update and cleared or set as a group by led_frame_set_group_all), bit 2 (lcd_fb_set_d1_bit2), bit 3 (set from the flag 0x20001d38 in the renderer) and bit 6 (lcd_fb_set_d1_bit6). Bit 4 is paired with bit 3 of led_indicator_d4.

vcu_g_0159_200021d2.name: led_indicator_d2
vcu_g_0159_200021d2.description: LED frame byte d2: bits 0..3 are the indicator pattern of the display state (set by the renderer for states 2, 9 and 0x0B and by led_frame_apply_mode_pattern); together with byte d3 it forms the 16-bit output word changed by led_frame_set_bit16.

vcu_g_0159_200021d4.name: led_indicator_d4
vcu_g_0159_200021d4.description: LED frame byte d4 of indicator bits: bits 0..1 (lcd_fb_set_d4_low2), bit 2 (lcd_fb_set_d4_bit2), bit 3 (paired with bit 4 of led_indicator_d1 by led_frame_set_pair_d1_d4), bits 4..5 (lcd_fb_set_d4_bits45) and the icon group B bits 4..6 (mask 0x70).

vcu_g_0159_200021d5.name: led_indicator_d5
vcu_g_0159_200021d5.description: LED frame byte d5: low nibble is icon group B (lcd_fb_set_icon_group_b sets 0x0F and clears 0xF0 with it); cleared by the renderer in several states.

vcu_g_0159_200021d6.name: led_anim_row
vcu_g_0159_200021d6.description: Row index of the LED row animation, 0..17: rows 0..8 are drawn rising (row = index) and 9..17 falling (row = 0x11 - index) by vcu_led_pattern_anim_step. Incremented after each drawn row and reset at the end of a sequence.

vcu_g_0159_200021d8.name: led_anim_ticks
vcu_g_0159_200021d8.description: Tick counter of the LED row animation: incremented each renderer tick, and the animation only advances on ticks where it is a multiple of 3.

vcu_g_0159_200021da.name: led_anim_phase
vcu_g_0159_200021da.description: Phase of the LED row animation: 0 = draw rows 0..8 (rising), 1 = draw rows 9..17 while clearing the earlier rows, 2 = clear the remaining rows, and then the sequence completes (display_anim_done is set).

vcu_g_0159_200021de.name: display_anim_step
vcu_g_0159_200021de.description: Step counter of vcu_display_anim_step, incremented per call and wrapped at 100. In sub-mode 10 the icons are off at steps 50..99 (blink), and in sub-mode 12 the upward sweep steps when the counter is a multiple of display_sweep_up_period (0x200014f2).

vcu_g_0159_200021e2.name: display_sweep_div
vcu_g_0159_200021e2.description: Tick counter of the downward segment sweep (vcu_display_sweep_down_step): incremented each call and reset when the sweep is off. The sweep steps when it is a multiple of display_sweep_period (0x200014f0).

vcu_g_0159_200021e6.name: warn_list_count
vcu_g_0159_200021e6.description: Number of valid entries in the active warning list at 0x20002248 (0..64). Rebuilt by vcu_warning_list_rebuild from the four 16-bit warning bitmap words 0x200022ce, 0x200022d0, 0x200022d2 and 0x200022d4 (copies of 0x20001cd8..0x20001cde), and also reset to 0 by the renderer in several display states.

vcu_g_0159_20002248.name: warn_list
vcu_g_0159_20002248.description: Element 0 of the active warning code list. Writers store one byte per entry: bit i of bitmap word k adds the code 10+i (word 0), 26+i (word 1), 42+i (word 2) or 58+i (word 3), so codes are in the 10..73 range; the list length is warn_list_count (0x200021e6), at most 64. Readers in display states 1, 3, 8 and 0x0B and in the VCU_0159 level gauge index it as bytes. Elements 1 and up are described in the diagnostics packet (diag_warning_list), which reads them as u16; that disagrees with the byte accesses in the decompile.

vcu_g_0159_200022dd.name: led_display_ctrl
vcu_g_0159_200022dd.description: TM1640 display-control byte passed to vcu_led_tm1640_frame_commit. The 0x80 bit switches the display on and the low three bits set the brightness; the init path sends 0x87 (on, brightness 7). lighting_fade_step ramps it through 0x81..0x86 (probably dimming).
